After platform recovery, you said you needed to reduce demands and sleep before the next workday; sustained noise and long social settings worsen your fatigue and tinnitus. Even if the scheduling clash is resolved, you said you would still need a quiet, shorter format. Ask for a brief, quiet, remote or otherwise shortened alternative instead.
